title: The Global T20 Nomad: AD Russell's Journey Across 10 Leagues
summary: AD Russell has played in 10 T20 leagues (BBL, BPL, CPL, ILT20, IPL), scoring 8621 runs at 26.9.
body:
## 10 Leagues, One Mission

AD Russell is one of T20 cricket's true globetrotters. From the IPL to the BBL, from the CPL to the PSL, he's plied his trade across **10 different T20 leagues**: BBL, BPL, CPL, ILT20, IPL, LPL, MLC, PSL, SA20, T20I.

**Career Numbers:** 8621 runs | 443 innings | Avg 26.9 | SR 167.5

That kind of cross-league experience shapes a player. Different pitches, different pressure, different tactical demands — and Russell has delivered across all of them.
